initial.title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-04] Internal review
initial.goal: Produce one findings-first internal review register for the exact final v0.92.1 milestone candidate.
initial.required_outcome: A complete review denominator and canonical finding register expose every gap, partial implementation, inert path, unsupported claim, and release blocker at one exact candidate revision.
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue work on main
Do not execute before #519 has a reviewed green merge
Review complete denominators rather than samples
Do not merge, deploy, restart Runtime, or spend provider/cloud funds
initial.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one internal findings register; individual findings do not close independently.
deliverables: Complete v0.92.1 issue/PR and acceptance-surface inventory
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every changed production file, test/proof file, canonical document, milestone issue/PR, and acceptance surface is inventoried and dispositioned
AC-2: Every finding binds exact evidence, severity, revision, impact, source lane, and owner
AC-3: The synthesis explicitly identifies partial, inert, unreachable, unproven, and documentation-only outcomes
AC-4: No empty, capped, sampled, zero-test, or CI-only lane is credited as a pass
AC-5: Packet manifests, counts, redaction, portability, and exact-head identity validate
dependencies: TAIL-03/#519 reviewed green merge is live and supplies the immutable candidate
non_goals: Merge, deployment, Runtime restart, or paid execution
initial.plan_summary: After #519 merges, freeze its exact candidate, build complete path/issue/acceptance denominators, run findings-first specialist lanes, synthesize all raw findings, validate the packet, and obtain exact-head review.

steps.action: Verify #519 reviewed merge truth and freeze full base/candidate SHAs.
Build complete changed-path, issue/PR, acceptance-surface, canonical-doc, demo, and evidence inventories without sampling.
Run bounded findings-first specialist lanes covering every inventoried row.
Synthesize raw findings, acceptance coverage, disagreements, blockers, and #522 dispositions into one canonical register.
Validate counts, schemas, digests, redaction, portability, and exact-head identity; obtain independent packet review.

affected_areas: production code and tests changed in the release range
invariants: The candidate stays immutable during review
Green CI never replaces semantic review
risks: A truncated inventory could hide half-work
Late candidate drift could stale reviews
Lifecycle or docs claims could overstate implementation
Parallel lane results could overlap or omit rows
stop_conditions: #519 is not a reviewed green merge

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove every changed path, milestone issue/PR, acceptance surface, and mandatory lane is inventoried and dispositioned.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Validator and packet are #520 execution deliverables.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove raw findings, canonical register, synthesis, and acceptance matrix agree exactly.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Validator and packet are #520 execution deliverables.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove candidate identity, ancestry, artifact digests, portability, and redaction.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Validator and packet are #520 execution deliverables.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on dependency, candidate, denominator, evidence, redaction, schema, review, or exact-revision drift; retain limitations and never convert missing proof into a pass.
review_prompts: Does the review inventory every changed production and test file rather than sample?
Does every acceptance surface map to implementation and meaningful proof?
Are half-work, inert paths, do-nothing behavior, and unsupported claims explicit findings?
Do all findings and zero-finding lane results bind the exact candidate?
initial.review_scope: The complete final v0.92.1 base-to-candidate change set, milestone issue/PR roster, acceptance surfaces, canonical documentation, proof, demos, lifecycle truth, and release claims.
